extension.summary: Upload kodi.log to paste.kodi.tv and show the link
extension.description:
Uploads the Kodi log to paste.kodi.tv and shows the resulting link so it can be shared when asking for help.
Credentials are stripped before upload by default: tokens, API keys, passwords, Authorization headers and any user:pass embedded in a URL are replaced with <redacted>. A raw upload is offered separately for when the redaction itself is hiding the problem.
Logs larger than the paste service accepts are trimmed to the most recent portion, which is the part that matters, and the paste says so at the top.
No dependencies beyond Kodi itself, so it still works on a fresh profile when the add-on you are trying to debug will not start.
